description: This file defines the main SwiftUI view for displaying and managing a list of notes in a note-taking app. It includes the main view structure, search functionality, note display, navigation to editors, and UI components like floating action buttons.

classes.name: NotesListView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view displaying a list of notes, with search, navigation, and actions.

classes.name: SearchField
classes.description: Private SwiftUI view encapsulating the search text input field.

classes.name: NoteCard
classes.description: Private SwiftUI view that displays individual note summary in the list.

classes.name: FloatingActionButton
classes.description: Private SwiftUI view for the floating button to create new notes.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the main view hierarchy with navigation, search, list, and buttons.
